## PlatformInfo.arch property

The CPU architecture identifier.

**Signature:**

```typescript
arch: string;
```

## Remarks

Common values include:

<ul> <li><code>x64</code> (64-bit Intel/AMD)</li> <li><code>arm64</code> (64-bit ARM)</li> <li><code>ia32</code> (32-bit Intel/AMD)</li> <li><code>arm</code> (32-bit ARM)</li> </ul>

Corresponds to <code>process.arch</code> from Node.js.
